value.rationale: Proposed pending accepted-only repeat calibration: pooled upper clustered CI95 at most 0.005 nats mean error. The available accepted-only neutral replay reached 0.002744 nats upper CI; 0.005 is 5% of the 0.1 absolute floor (20 times tighter) and four times tighter than the existing 0.02 informational mean margin. Pooled net top-one upper CI95 at most 0.01; category mean point increase at most 0.01 nats; ordinal severity harm uses a one-sided sign test on per-text net severity changes with Holm alpha 0.05 across categories. Require eight texts for CI gating, otherwise pooled evidence is insufficient unless explicitly permitted by allow_sparse_pooled; categories use point mean rules and whole-text harm tests. Allow at most two net positions whose absolute error grows by more than 0.5 nats. All values require operator approval before candidate capture.
